200.title: Polish right-wing opposition MPs call for Independence Day march in Ukrainian city of Lviv
200.summary: Polish right-wing opposition MPs call for Independence Day march in Ukrainian city of Lviv Sep 17, 2026 | History , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
200.body: Polish right-wing opposition MPs call for Independence Day march in Ukrainian city of Lviv Sep 17, 2026 | History , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! A group of MPs from Poland’s main right-wing and far-right opposition parties have jointly called on the government to organise a march on Polish Independence Day in the Ukrainian city of Lviv, which was historically part of Poland. By contrast, argued the signatories, Polish state entities provide funding for Ukrainian organisations and events in Poland, including celebrations of Ukrainian Independence Day on 24 August. As such, they called upon the government to “organise official celebrations of [Polish] Independence Day in Lviv, including a Polish Independence March through the streets of the city” on 11 November.

200.title: Poland will strengthen its electronic security along the border with Ukraine
200.summary: News World Poland will strengthen its electronic security along the border with Ukraine UA NEWS 17 September 2026 09:37 --> Poland plans to equip more than 100 km of its land border with Ukraine with an electronic security system. Thus, Poland plans to simultaneously strengthen both the physical and electronic components of the security of its eastern borders, particularly the more than 100 km of border with Ukraine.
200.body: News World Poland will strengthen its electronic security along the border with Ukraine UA NEWS 17 September 2026 09:37 --> Poland plans to equip more than 100 km of its land border with Ukraine with an electronic security system. According to Violeta Gorzkówska , one of the projects involves electronic protection of 69 km of the border within the area of responsibility of the Nadbużański Division of the Polish Border Guard . Thus, Poland plans to simultaneously strengthen both the physical and electronic components of the security of its eastern borders, particularly the more than 100 km of border with Ukraine. Poland has begun constructing new fortifications and reinforcing border crossing points along the border with Ukraine due to the growing threat from Russia.

300.title: CJ ENM eyes European growth with major brand push in Poland
300.summary: Studio Dragon Chief Producer Kim Tae-hoon, center, leads a talk session on "The Legend of Kitchen Soldier" during the 2026 Korea-Poland Brand Week in Poland, Wednesday. Following its participation in the 2026 Korea-Poland Brand Week in Warsaw on Tuesday and Wednesday, the media company announced plans Thursday to accelerate content distribution and forge local production alliances across the region.
300.body: Studio Dragon Chief Producer Kim Tae-hoon, center, leads a talk session on "The Legend of Kitchen Soldier" during the 2026 Korea-Poland Brand Week in Poland, Wednesday. Following its participation in the 2026 Korea-Poland Brand Week in Warsaw on Tuesday and Wednesday, the media company announced plans Thursday to accelerate content distribution and forge local production alliances across the region. During the two-day event, CJ ENM signed a memorandum of understanding with the Korean Cultural Center in Poland and KOCCA to expand the reach of Korean content in the country. A CJ ENM content distribution official said the event provided a meaningful opportunity to connect with local institutions and industry figures and to lay the groundwork for spreading Korean content in Poland, adding that the company will keep working closely with local partners to introduce more of its content and expand opportunities for European viewers to access it.

400.summary: Sep 17, 2026 Von der Leyen positions biomethane as Europe’s strategic energy independence tool In her 2026 State of the Union Address, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has placed biomethane squarely at the centre of Europe's energy independence strategy, positioning renewable gas alongside nuclear and renewables as critical to breaking fossil fuel dependency and driving down energy costs.
400.body: Sep 17, 2026 Von der Leyen positions biomethane as Europe’s strategic energy independence tool In her 2026 State of the Union Address, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has placed biomethane squarely at the centre of Europe's energy independence strategy, positioning renewable gas alongside nuclear and renewables as critical to breaking fossil fuel dependency and driving down energy costs. The Commission President highlighted the financial toll of fossil fuel dependence, stating that imported fossil fuels have cost Europe an additional €90 billion since the start of the conflict – "without a single molecule of energy added." Energy independence through diversification The Commission's approach emphasises technological diversity rather than pursuing a single energy pathway.

600.title: Bulgaria defeats Poland 3-2 in EuroVolley 2026 volleyball thriller
600.summary: Bulgarian volleyball has once again surprised the world, taking down the reigning European champions, Poland, with a 3:2 set score (25:20, 31:29, 25:23, 25:19, 20:18) in a thriller during the final fifth round of EuroVolley 2026.
600.body: Bulgarian volleyball has once again surprised the world, taking down the reigning European champions, Poland, with a 3:2 set score (25:20, 31:29, 25:23, 25:19, 20:18) in a thriller during the final fifth round of EuroVolley 2026. Poland has already guaranteed first place with the same record of four wins and one loss, but with 13 points.In the round of 16, the Bulgarian team will battle Germany on September 19 (Saturday) in Sofia at 19:00, while Poland will face Latvia three hours later.At the start of the match, strong serves proved crucial for both teams, but the Poles demonstrated superior strength in service and blocking, allowing them to secure a 5-point lead. Despite powerful attacks from the reigning runners-up bringing them back within 3 points, the "Polish squad" held firm through their service and won 25:19, leveling the match.In the deciding fifth set, Alexander Nikolov and Bardarov pushed Bulgaria to a 4:0 lead through their successful attacks.
